rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical violence and harm between people.

example.english: This movie has a lot of violence.
example.traditional: 呢套戲有好多暴力場面。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jau5 hou2 do1 bou6 lik6 coeng4 min6

rows.note: Use this for clashes or fighting between opposing groups, especially when the conflict is ongoing.

example.english: The violence between the two groups has not stopped.
example.traditional: 兩個團體嘅衝突仲未停止。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 tyun4 tai2 ge3 cung1 dat6 zung6 mei6 ting4 zi2

rows.note: Use this for the extreme force or power of a storm or other natural phenomenon rather than for interpersonal violence.

example.english: The violence of this typhoon is truly frightening.
example.traditional: 呢場颱風嘅威力真係好驚人。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 toi4 fung1 ge3 wai1 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 geng1 jan4
